_help.New: Filled in automatically: open apps that have no weight yet. Move each name into a group under Weights.
_help.Hotkey: Shortcut that arranges the windows. Run Setup.ps1 again after changing it.
_help.RestoreHotkey: Shortcut that maximizes all apps again. Run Setup.ps1 again after changing it.
_help.Gap: Space in px between windows and to the screen edge (at 100% display scaling; scaled automatically).
_help.MinWidth: Narrowest allowed window in px (at 100% scaling). If apps don't fit, the least important one is minimized.
_help.MinHeight: Lowest allowed window in px (at 100% scaling). Same rule as MinWidth.
_help.Layout: Each monitor gets the best mix of columns (side by side) and rows (stacked): important apps get more space, every window stays readable. What doesn't fit readably is minimized.
_help.Weights: Process names (Task Manager > Details, without .exe) grouped by how much you use them. Higher = more space and minimized later. Equal weight: the app you used last stays.
_help.Weights 3 and up: You work in it directly: main monitor.
_help.Weights below 3: Second monitor (or main monitor if you only have one). Apps not listed count as 1.
_help.Weights any number: Any number works as a group, e.g. "4.5": [...] to rank apps between 4 and 5.
_help.WideApps: Apps that need width (videos, websites): they get wide slots (about 1280 px) instead of narrow columns when possible.
_help.GameFolders: Anything started from these folders counts as a game and is never touched. Write backslashes twice.
